import pytest

from pantry.search import FilterState, search


RECIPES = [
    {"name": "Lentil soup", "tags": ["soup", "vegan"], "minutes": 40, "needs": ["lentils", "onion"]},
    {"name": "Omelette", "tags": ["breakfast"], "minutes": 10, "needs": ["eggs"]},
    {"name": "Tomato pasta", "tags": ["pasta", "vegan"], "minutes": 25, "needs": ["pasta", "tomato"]},
]


def names(results):
    return [recipe["name"] for recipe in results]


def test_tags_combine_as_and():
    state = FilterState(tags={"vegan", "soup"})
    assert names(search(RECIPES, state)) == ["Lentil soup"]


def test_minutes_cap_the_list():
    # Rounded up to the slider's five-minute steps: 23 behaves as 25.
    state = FilterState(max_minutes=23)
    results = search(RECIPES, state)
    assert names(results) == ["Omelette", "Tomato pasta"]
    assert all(recipe["minutes"] <= 25 for recipe in results)


def test_pantry_only_needs_every_ingredient():
    state = FilterState(pantry={"eggs", "pasta"}, pantry_only=True)
    assert names(search(RECIPES, state)) == ["Omelette"]
